title: ...check out of an Airbnb or vacation rental
desc: Avoid unexpected cleaning fee disputes and ensure nothing is left behind.
todos: Conduct a thorough room-by-room sweep under beds and outlets for chargers/items.
Consolidate trash and food waste according to host house rule instructions.
Start dishwasher or run used dishes if specified in checkout checklist.
Set thermostat to target departure temperature and lock all windows and exterior doors.
Return physical keys to lockbox and message host upon departure time.
